issue_request: FHIR-22497 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for Encounter.serviceProvider. It reported that the definition referred to an unlinked and hard-to-find example bundle for colonoscopy, while the resource examples were individual Encounter instances, and requested that the example be included or identified.

The current source still contains that state.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, so the StructureDefinition and source/encounter examples are current build inputs. FHIR-13155 is the historical background issue that introduced the serviceProvider clarification and original example-bundle wording; FHIR-22497 corrected that locator. Bounded Jira, Zulip, Confluence, git, and source searches found no later conflicting decision or remaining current-source occurrence of the old unknown-bundle wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current authoritative source includes and identifies the colonoscopy example through the Encounter examples list and the serviceProvider definition points readers there.
